content.text:
Print-mode `prime-agent` runs are executed by a **daemon**, and the daemon binds its environment at *startup* (only `HERDR_*` client vars are forwarded per request) — so `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` exported in the client shell never reaches an already-running shared daemon, which keeps serving its original default home (`brainstem/prime-extension/tests/integration/run-integration.sh:12-17`).

Integration runs must therefore pass a **dedicated `--daemon-socket <per-run pipe>`**, forcing a fresh daemon spawned from the run's own process to inherit `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` (and `SECOND_BRAIN_OBSERVABILITY`), then `daemon shutdown --daemon-socket <pipe>` after the run; production instead requires setting `SECOND_BRAIN_HOME` *before* starting prime-agent.
